\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch5:5-19

Use $\mathbb {H}^2$ with the metric $\tilde{g}$ to construct an interpretation of Hilbert's axioms with the hyperbolic parallel postulate substituted for the Euclidean one, and prove that the incidence postulates, congruence postulate (e), and the hyperbolic parallel postulate are theorems in this geometry. (Used on p. 144.) \end{exercise}
